title: Declare goods that you're moving to or from Northern Ireland using the Trader Support Service (TSS)
text:
This new version of the Trader Support Service ( TSS ) replaces the  outgoing Trader Support Service . It’s free to use and gives you access to:

 • an online system for making customs and safety and security declarations for movements between Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) and Northern Ireland

 • guidance on how to use the service, including regular webinars and email bulletins 

 • a digital assistant and contact centre support agents to help with your declarations

 If you’re not already signed up to the Trader Support Service, you’ll need to register to declare goods that you’re moving to or from Northern Ireland .

 Read more about what to do when moving goods to or from Northern Ireland as part of your business.

 Who can use this service

 You can use this service if you are making a declaration yourself, or on behalf of someone else, or as a business involved in the physical movement of goods (for example if you are a haulier).

 What you can use the Trader Support Service to do

 You can use this service to:

 • draft and submit customs, safety and security declarations

 • access support and guidance for moving goods between Great Britain and Northern Ireland

 • check your balance and make payments for any duties owed to HMRC

 • add or update your company details and customs authorisations

 • add or remove permissions for another business to act on your behalf, invite or remove users from your account, or appoint account administrators

 If your business is already using the Trader Support Service

 You’ll need to be invited to sign up as an additional user if the business is already registered to use the Trader Support Service. Ask the account administrator for the business to send you an invitation. It will arrive by email.

 Sign in to use the Trader Support Service

 You’ll need the sign in details you used when you registered for the Trader Support Service .
